title: Which colour says what? A guide to flowers by occasion
body:
Choosing flowers is easier when you know what each colour says. Pink, red, white and yellow cover most gifts: red for love, pink for thanks and new babies, white for weddings and remembrance, and yellow for cheer and get-well wishes.

| Occasion | Best colours | What it says |
| Birthday | Mixed bright colours, sunflower yellow, warm pinks | Cheerful and celebratory |
| Anniversary / Valentine's | Red or pink | Red is love and passion; pink is admiration |
| Wedding | White, cream, soft blush | Purity and peace |
| New baby | Soft pink or pastel blue | The classic baby colours |
| Thank you | Pink | Gratitude and sweetness |
| Get well | Yellow | Friendship, happiness, optimism |
| Congratulations, new job, graduation | Yellow, orange, red mixes | Enthusiasm and energy |
| Retirement or milestone | Purple | Success and admiration |
| Mother's Day | Pink, plus white and yellow | Pink carnations are motherly love |
| Sympathy and funerals | White, soft pastels, blue, or the person's favourite flower | White is peace and remembrance; blue is comfort |
| Grave pots and remembrance | White, soft colours, or the person's favourite | Calm and respectful; a favourite flower can comfort the family |
| Remembrance Sunday | Red poppies; white poppies for peace | Traditional remembrance colours |

For the seasons, we like orange, purple and black for Halloween, red, white and green for Christmas, and soft pastels for Easter and spring. Not sure what to choose? Tell us who it's for and we'll suggest a colour, or make something to order in your own colours.
